note: Absolute bitstream column base for a tile column: bit_col = column_base[tile_col] - ram_col.  For 48-column tiles the base is the slice-D block origin + 44, corrected per tile column against 305 routed vendor bitstreams (PLC).  For the 59-column edge tiles, tile columns 1 and 49 are measured directly against 551 and 1086 routed instances; columns 0 and 50 have no bitstream columns of their own (their I/O cells are configured by the neighbouring 59-column block).
